hook: A massive 1.27 million dollar arbitration award victory just went to Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde.

sections.voiceover: A massive 1.27 million dollar arbitration award victory just went to Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde.
In 2023, former nanny Ericka Genaro sued actors Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde. Did the former nanny Ericka Genaro succeed in her legal battle against the famous acting pair?

text_overlay.text: Ericka Genaro vs. Sudeikis and Wilde

sections.voiceover: The arbitration panel ultimately dismissed all 8 claims brought against Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde.
TMZ reports the pair filed a petition in New York to confirm this final arbitration ruling.
A New York judge must now formally confirm the 1.27 million dollar award for them.
